name: Old Success Inn
accommodation: 23 bedrooms: 13 above the inn and 10 contemporary annexe rooms overlooking the beach, including sea-view doubles and family rooms
beachAccess: Overlooks Sennen Cove and is a stone's throw from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant and café, bar, terrace overlooking the cove, WiFi, parking
overview: A St Austell Brewery inn that sits just above the sands at Sennen Cove. It has 23 bedrooms, ten of them in a newer annexe overlooking the beach, plus sea-view doubles and family rooms. There is a restaurant, a bar and a large terrace looking over the cove, and Land's End is a coastal walk away.
surfTripFit: You can see the surf from the terrace and walk down to the beach in a minute or two.
